data.title: China Sunshine Subsidiary Enters RMB35 Million Entrusted Loan Agreement
data.description:
China Sunshine Paper Holdings Co. Ltd. ( (HK:2002) ) has shared an announcement.

On 23 November 2026, Century Sunshine, a subsidiary of China Sunshine Paper Holdings, entered into an entrusted loan agreement with a lending bank and Fuchang Nongye. The RMB35 million loan, funded from the Group’s internal resources, carries interest at one-year LPR plus 395 basis points, matures on 23 November 2027 and is intended for Fuchang Nongye’s general working capital.

Fuchang Nongye must pay interest monthly and repay the principal by maturity. The agreement was aggregated with two earlier entrusted loans involving borrowers wholly owned by the State-owned Assets Operation Center of Changle County, making the transactions a discloseable transaction subject to the Listing Rules’ reporting and announcement requirements.

data.title: Yuexiu Property Announces Special Dividend Distribution in Yuexiu REIT Units
data.description:
Yuexiu Property Co ( (HK:0123) ) has issued an announcement.

Yuexiu Property Co’s board resolved on 23 November 2026 to declare a special dividend through an in-specie distribution of approximately 491,097,935 Yuexiu REIT units indirectly held through Yuexiu Investment. The entitlement is 122 units for every 1,000 company shares held on the Record Date, subject to adjustments.

Entitlement is determined by shareholders whose names appear on the register on 10 December 2026. Fractional entitlements will be rounded down, while fractional and undistributed units will be sold, with net proceeds retained for the company, except for units sold for non-qualifying shareholders.

data.description:

data.title: Huaqin Proposes Application for Up to RMB3 Billion Debt Financing
data.description:
Huaqin Technology Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3296) ) has provided an announcement.

The company proposes applying to NAFMII to register and issue debt financing instruments totaling no more than RMB3.0 billion. The proposed instruments may include ultra-short-term and short-term financing bills, medium-term notes, perpetual bonds and other NAFMII-recognized instruments, with issuance in one or more tranches subject to the registered quota and market conditions.

After issuance costs, proceeds are expected to support daily operations, repay interest-bearing debt, replenish working capital, fund investment and acquisitions, or serve other permitted purposes. The proposal was approved by the board and a board committee but remains subject to shareholder approval, while detailed terms and use of proceeds would be determined according to capital needs and market conditions.

data.title: South China Vocational Education Group Reports Profit for Eight Months Ended August 31
data.description:
South China Vocational Education Group Co., Ltd. ( (HK:6913) ) has issued an announcement.

South China Vocational Education Group Company Limited reported revenue of RMB439.820 million for the eight months ended 31 August 2026, up 5.8% from RMB415.553 million in the comparable 2025 period. Gross profit rose 8.1% to RMB80.399 million, while profit before tax was RMB10.311 million versus a RMB37.343 million loss previously and profit for the period was RMB24.975 million versus a RMB143.845 million loss.

The Group reported total comprehensive income of RMB26.684 million, compared with a RMB61.050 million loss for the year ended 31 December 2025; basic and diluted earnings per share were RMB0.02 versus a loss per share of RMB0.11. The Directors did not recommend a final dividend for the eight months ended 31 August 2026, following no dividend for the year ended 31 December 2025.

data.title: China Kepei Issues Profit Warning as Preliminary FY2026 Net Profit Expected to Decline
data.description:
China Kepei Education Group Limited ( (HK:1890) ) just unveiled an announcement.

China Kepei Education Group Limited is an education group; the release does not specify its primary products, services or market focus.

The company issued a profit warning based on a preliminary review, with revenue and gross profit expected to increase approximately 10% to 15% year on year in FY2026, while net profit is expected to decrease approximately 35% to 40% from RMB748.4 million in FY2025. The anticipated decline is mainly attributed to additional corporate income tax expenses and late-payment surcharges following a local tax authority reassessment, together with the FY2026 tax provision.

The figures are unaudited and subject to finalisation and potential adjustments. The FY2026 annual results announcement is expected by the end of November 2026, and shareholders and potential investors were advised to exercise caution when dealing in the company’s securities.

data.title: Huaqin Sets Rules for Board Audit and Risk Management Committee
data.description:
Huaqin Technology Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3296) ) has shared an update.

Huaqin Co., Ltd., a joint stock company incorporated in the People’s Republic of China and identified by stock code 3296, sets out rules for its Board audit and risk management committee. The rules state that the committee is intended to strengthen Board decision-making, conduct pre-audits and professional audits, supervise management, and enhance risk identification and prevention.

The committee must comprise three non-executive or independent directors, with a majority of independent directors and an accounting professional from among the independent directors as convenor. Its remit covers external and internal audit oversight, financial information and disclosure review, internal controls, compliance and risk-management systems, risk strategies and major solutions, and specified supervisory powers; the internal audit department is its day-to-day administrative body.

data.title: Transcenta Doses First Subject in TST002 Phase 2b Osteoporosis Trial
data.description:
Transcenta Holding Limited ( (HK:6628) ) has shared an update.

Transcenta Holding Limited is developing Blosozumab (TST002), a humanized monoclonal antibody licensed from Eli Lilly for Greater China, to treat osteoporosis. The antibody has a dual mechanism that promotes bone formation and inhibits bone resorption, and is being developed for more than 90 million osteoporosis patients in China.

Transcenta said it dosed the first subject on Nov. 23, 2026, in a China Phase 2b trial of TST002. The study evaluates efficacy and safety of once-every-three-month dosing for 12 months in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis and low bone mass.

An earlier China Phase 1b/2a study involved 32 subjects receiving a single dose; by Day 85, average lumbar-spine BMD rose 3.52% to 6.20% and total-hip BMD rose 1.30% to 2.24% after doses up to 1,200 mg. The company said the first-dosing milestone marked clinical pipeline development in osteoporosis.

data.title: Tianqi Lithium Chairwoman Proposes A-Share Repurchase
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Tianqi Lithium Corp. Class H ( (HK:9696) ).

Tianqi Lithium said its chairwoman proposed that the company repurchase part of its issued A shares using its own or self-raised funds through centralized bidding on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, subject to Board consideration and approval. The stated purposes are cancellation, safeguarding the company’s value and shareholders’ interests, and potential share-incentive or employee share-ownership schemes.

The proposed funding range is RMB400 million to RMB800 million, with the repurchase price capped at 150% of the average share price over the 30 trading days before the Board considers the proposal. The announced terms specify a 12-month period from Board approval, while the final amount, price and number of shares remain subject to the approved proposal and circumstances at expiry.
